heroHeadline: DtMF Tour Heads to Lisbon — Adidas Flamboyan 'Vivid Red' Drops May 30 as Madrid 10-Night Residency Looms
heroSubtitle: Following sold-out two-night concerts at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona (May 22–23, 54,000/night), Bad Bunny positions for Lisbon's May 26–27 dates at Estádio da Luz — the penultimate European stop before his landmark 10-night residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid beginning May 30. That same day, the Adidas x Bad Bunny Ballerina 'Flamboyan' (KI7916, Vivid Red, $120) goes on wide release via Adidas Confirmed — inspired by Puerto Rico's flamboyan tree and previewed within the Zara 'BENITO ANTONIO' 150-piece collection that launched May 21. The European campaign began with the Puerto Rico pop-up at Plaza Las Américas (May 16), which generated viral coverage before the global launch, followed by the official announcement wave (May 19) and the Barcelona opening-night debut of the European tour (May 22). 'DtMF' holds 60 consecutive weeks at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs — the all-time chart record — with no chart slippage. The Porto Rico epic film (directed by Residente, co-starring Viggo Mortensen, Edward Norton, and Javier Bardem) remains in pre-production with principal photography expected late 2026.
